name.description: Project name shown in the top bar.

logo.description: Optional path (relative to project root) to an image used in place of the Prezl mark.

color.description: Color family override (violet, sky, yellow, orange, emerald, cyan, red, indigo, pink, amber, slate).

not.description: Use either `preview:` (single object) or `previews:` (array), not both.

preview.description: Single-preview shorthand. For multiple previews use `previews:` (array) instead.

previews.description: List of previews available on this stage. The Run button opens a picker when more than one is configured. At most one entry may have `autoLaunch: 'start'` and at most one `'end'`.

cover.description: Stage agenda — files (and optional anchors) the presenter wants to remember to discuss during this stage. Surfaced as a clickable checklist under the file tree.

reset.description: When true, entering this stage from another collapses tabs to the resolved open file and resets explorer expansion monotonically toward less clutter.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: `path`, `path#id`, `path@line`, or `path#id@line` (suffixes optional, either order). Falls back to the literal path when the suffix can't be parsed (e.g. npm-scoped `@types/foo.ts` or `@head` non-numeric tags).
Explicit `~` clears the open file — empty editor pane.
Explicit `~` clears this step's previews even when the stage has a default — there's no step-to-step inheritance, so omit instead if you want the stage default.
Explicit `~` clears this step's previews even when the stage has a default — there's no step-to-step inheritance, so omit instead if you want the stage default.

cover.description: One cover item (string or object) or several (array). The Run picker doesn't apply here — cover is a checklist surfaced under the file tree.

oneOf.description: Explicit `~` clears this step's cover even when the stage has a default — omit instead if you want the stage default.
Shorthand: `path`, `path#id`, `path@line`, or `path#id@line` — same shape as `open` shorthand.

title.description: Optional human label for the cover row; falls back to the file's basename otherwise.
Optional human label; surfaced as the row label in the Run picker when a screen has more than one preview. Falls back to the URL.
Optional human label; surfaced as the row label in the Run picker when a screen has more than one preview. Falls back to the file basename.

autoLaunch.description: `true`/`'start'` opens at scope start; `'end'` opens at scope end (forward-advance). Once an `'end'` video has fired it won't re-fire in the same session.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: step alias only, no overrides.

not.description: Use either `preview:` (single object) or `previews:` (array), not both.

preview.description: Single-preview shorthand for the step. Omit to inherit the stage default; use `~` to explicitly clear (this step has no previews even if the stage does); for multiple previews use `previews:` (array). No step-to-step chain — declaring on step 2 does not carry into step 3.

previews.description: Plural list form for step-level preview override. Same resolution as `preview` — omit → stage default, value → override, `~` → explicitly empty.

cover.description: Step-level cover override. Same resolution as previews: omit → stage default, value → override, `~` → explicitly empty.
